foreman_ivo.name: Ivo
foreman_ivo.description: The station's last foreman, still wearing the harness, still logging hours nobody pays for.

dialog.greeting: Mind the bench. Strip what you can carry, log what you take, and stay out of the hold.

foreman_ivo.default_dialog: Ivo watches the corridor, one hand on the rail.

cargo_drone.name: cargo drone
cargo_drone.description: A loading drone running a corrupted pickup loop. It has decided you are freight.

dialog.greeting: The drone pivots toward you with a hydraulic whine.
dialog.flee: The drone retreats into the racks, still humming.

cargo_drone.default_dialog: The drone traces a slow arc through the hold.
